native_context: MCP resource, client and downstream token authority
taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.boundary: MCP resource, client and downstream token authority — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Record protocol/transport, MCP client/resource/authorization server identities, token resource/audience, per-client consent and downstream credential path. Treat stdio and remote transports according to their actual design.
controls.controlled_verification: With owned local fixtures compare the intended client/resource token and consent against a wrong-resource or wrong-client context at the real validation gate. Trace whether a proxy passes a token to an unintended downstream resource or reuses consent for an unrelated client.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A trusted connection is not authority for every operation. A synthetic token fixture tests gate logic only; it does not prove a real authorization server issued or a remote server accepted the same token.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Validate resource/client/actor context, bind consent and use appropriate downstream delegation under the current protocol contract. Retest intended integration, wrong audience/client and revoked consent.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
